rows.ARS:
Medium red Hybrid Tea.
Registration name: KORgund81
Exhibition name: Loving Memory
rows.Origin:
Bred by Reimer Kordes (1922-1997) (Germany, 1981).
Introduced in Germany by Rosen-Tantau/Tantau Roses in 1981 as 'Burgund 81'.
rows.Bloom: Crimson - scarlet. Mild fragrance. 40 petals. Average diameter 5". Very large, full (26-40 petals), high-centered bloom form. Blooms in flushes throughout the season.
rows.Habit:
Medium, bushy, upright. Medium, semi-glossy, medium green foliage.

Height: 3' to 4'11" (90 to 150cm). Width: 30" (75cm).
rows.Growing: USDA zone 7b and warmer. Can be used for beds and borders, cut flower, exhibition or garden. Disease susceptibility: very disease resistant. Spring Pruning: Remove old canes and dead or diseased wood and cut back canes that cross. In warmer climates, cut back the remaining canes by about one-third. In colder areas, you'll probably find you'll have to prune a little more than that. Requires spring freeze protection (see glossary - Spring freeze protection) . Can be grown in the ground or in a container (container requires winter protection).
